smog.warning: Warning: smog rising – slight production penalty.
smog.title: Smog
smog.footer: Positive rate increases smog, negative reduces it.

eco.title: Eco-reputation
eco.howToImprove: How to improve: plant forests 🌲, upgrade to cleaner boiler, reduce smog.
eco.effect: Effect: influences events and ViCoin bonus.
eco.low: Low eco-reputation – consider planting forests and cleaner sources.

events.noPending: No pending events. Everything under control.

steelBoiler.title: Steel heating boiler (1917–1928)
steelBoiler.desc: Boilers made of welded steel pipes – more durable, heat up faster and use less fuel than traditional ones.

triola.title: Triola boiler (1957)
triola.desc: Steel furnace with built-in water heater; easy conversion from coke to heating oil.

stainlessSteel.title: First stainless steel boiler (1972)
stainlessSteel.desc: Lighter and more efficient. Better heat exchange, less deposits, easier cleaning. Precursor to condensing boilers.

heatPump1978.title: First heat pump (1978)
heatPump1978.desc: Uses energy from the environment (air, ground) for heating purposes.

vitola.title: Low-temperature Vitola boiler (1978)
vitola.desc: Biferral with dual steel-cast iron surface. Works at ~40°C instead of ~70°C – adapts to demand.

vitodens.title: Vitodens gas boiler (1989)
vitodens.desc: Water vapor condensation from flue gases – higher efficiency and lower emissions than traditional devices.

vitocal.title: Heat pump (Vitocal)
vitocal.desc: High efficiency and renewable energy. Unlocks green installations in-game.

forest.title: Forest
forest.desc: Strongly reduces pollution (−0.5/s). Each additional forest is more expensive.

solarCollector.title: First solar collector (1972)
solarCollector.desc: Harnessing renewable solar energy, reducing oil or gas consumption.

condensing.title: Condensing technology (Inox‑Radial)
condensing.desc: Unlocks generation of gas condensing boilers and reduces emissions.

underfloorHeating.title: Underfloor heating
underfloorHeating.desc: Higher comfort at lower supply temperature – better efficiency. Shortens frost duration.

thermostatsSRC.title: SRC thermostats
thermostatsSRC.desc: Smart control – more precise regulation and savings. Increases resource generation.

inverter.title: Inverter / storage (Vitocharge)
inverter.desc: Energy storage and management. Better production utilization. Increases ViCoin generation.

grid.title: Grid
grid.desc: Connection to power grid – enables energy exchange. Increases ViCoin generation.

vitovalor.title: Vitovalor home fuel cell (2014)
vitovalor.desc: Produces electricity and heat from natural gas without traditional combustion ("cold" hydrogen oxidation reaction).

rdLab.title: R&D Laboratory
rdLab.desc: One-time investment. Very expensive, but permanently increases resource production (+0.02 ☀️/💧/🌬️, +0.01 💰). Available from the start.

relations.communityDesc: community gardens, clean air, pro-ecological decisions.
relations.communityTooltip:
What raises: planting forests, low smog emissions, pro-eco decisions (e.g., community garden, education).
What lowers: refusing to support initiatives, high smog.
Benefit thresholds: ≥25 – higher chance of favorable events; ≥50 – community initiatives may appear; ≤−25 – higher risk of criticism and fewer favorable options.
relations.suppliersTooltip:
What raises: agreements (MoU), joint campaigns, good modernization results.
What lowers: rejecting offers, focus on full independence.
Benefit thresholds: ≥10 – better offers; ≥25 – more frequent discounts and follow-ups; ≤−20 – some offers may be blocked.

timeline.steel1917Desc: More durable, heat up faster, less fuel consumption.
timeline.triola1957Desc: Steel furnace with heater – breakthrough in convenience and safety.
timeline.parola1965Desc: Lower emissions and high efficiency – step towards cleanliness.
timeline.stainless1972Desc: Better heat exchange, easier cleaning – foundation of condensation.
timeline.heatPump1978Desc: Ambient energy changes the rules of the game.
timeline.vitola1978Desc: Efficiency through operation at lower temperatures.
timeline.vitodens1989Desc: Vapor condensation – higher efficiency, lower emissions.
timeline.vitocal21stDesc: Modern heat pumps and renewable energy integration at home.
